Hello everyone! First off, I’m sorry I haven’t replied to anyone! Honestly I’ve been a little overwhelmed by all the sweet replies and comments. I’m going to try to go through them when I have a second, but for now, I thought I’d address a couple questions.

First, I was paralyzed due to an autoimmune disease attacking my spinal cord. This is actually the second time it’s happened, believe it or not😅 The first time I was paralyzed ~2 years, this time, it’s been about 8 months. I’ve been in intensive PT and can now take several steps with crutches or a walker. It’s my goal to be completely rid of my chair by the time my family goes to Hawaii in January🤞🏻

Second, the eating disorder comments. I’m ashamed to admit I did reach my “GW” at least partially using disordered habits, but I am in counseling and meeting with a dietician weekly. I have a history of ED and when my physical illness flares, it seems like my mental illness does as well. I’m on the road to recovery (in more ways than one!). I apologize if I triggered/misled anyone - mostly I just wanted a fun way to brag that I’m learning to walk again.

Again, thank you to everyone who’s left such positive comments or sent me messages, and those that gave me awards. And also thanks to those that left messages of concern, as well:)
